reason: Event-019 asks us to pay invoice NBL-005-INV-71 to 11-11-11 / 11111111 instead of the 00-00-00 / 00000000 on the invoice (event-018 and the attachment). It comes with no independent verification, which is a payment-redirection pattern, and the code flag forces escalation to accounts at P1. Policy says never to verify bank details through contacts in the same message and not to reply to the requester, so I have not replied or asked the provider. The invoice itself matches the property, the assigned provider and the £95 + VAT (£114) the landlord approved in event-008. The £460 repair estimate was not approved (event-016), and the job sheet requested in events 12, 14 and 17 is still outstanding. No payment instruction exists (event-020). Waiting or asking would not resolve suspected fraud, so a person in accounts must verify the bank details independently. Heating is running and no hazard is reported (event-013), so this is P1 for fraud and not P0. The job should not be closed.
options: Verify by phone on a number already on file, then pay the approved £114 to the confirmed account
Hold the invoice unpaid, warn the landlord and flag the mailbox
Obtain the job sheet and route the £460 repair to the landlord separately
